notes.general_comments: General comments Overall candidates did not perform very well on this paper. Of the candidates who sat this examination, only 32 per cent achieved a score of 15 or more correct answers. Questions 3, 12, and 14 proved straightforward, with more than 70 per cent of candidates identifying the correct key.
